notReleased.package.json: the private npm workspace root: it installs legacy/packages/ts as a workspace and takes @polyspec/ordered-json from its GitHub release through overrides
notReleased.composer.json: the private Composer root: it installs legacy/packages/php as a path repository and takes polyspec/ordered-json from its GitHub release zip
notReleased.packages/rust/Cargo.toml: the Cargo workspace of the Rust crates, no package of its own
notReleased.packages/rust/case-clock/Cargo.toml: a test support crate of the Rust client (publish = false)
notReleased.packages/rust/case-database/Cargo.toml: a test support crate of the Rust client (publish = false)
notReleased.packages/rust/test-support/Cargo.toml: a test support crate of the Rust client (publish = false)
notReleased.packages/rust/testcase/Cargo.toml: a test support crate of the Rust client (publish = false)
notReleased.packages/rust/tests/Cargo.toml: the integration tests of the Rust client (publish = false)
notReleased.packages/rust/build/tests/cases/Cargo.to: the test cases of the build crate, which the one Rust test program runs (publish = false)
notReleased.packages/rust/orm/tests/cases/Cargo.toml: the test cases of the orm crate, which the one Rust test program runs (publish = false)
notReleased.packages/rust/schema/tests/cases/Cargo.t: the test cases of the schema crate, which the one Rust test program runs (publish = false)
notReleased.packages/rust/testcase/tests/cases/Cargo: the test cases of the testcase crate, which the one Rust test program runs (publish = false)
notReleased.benchmarks/rust/Cargo.toml: the benchmark crate of the Rust client
notReleased.packages/rust/testing/interfaces/Cargo.t: the interface check crate of the Rust client
notReleased.legacy/packages/ts/testing/interfaces/ty: the TypeScript compiler of the interface check of the TypeScript client
notReleased.tests/go.mod: the Go module of the runners, physical tests and tool programs under tests/, which go.work joins to legacy/packages/go
notReleased.examples/go.mod: the Go module of the examples and their output test, which go.work joins to legacy/packages/go
notReleased.legacy/packages/ts/package.json: a language implementation of legacy/, kept for its own tests and as the other side of the differential tests until its removal (docs/spec/core.md CORE-1); the bindings of packages/rust/interface.json replace it
notReleased.legacy/packages/php/composer.json: a language implementation of legacy/, kept for its own tests and as the other side of the differential tests until its removal (docs/spec/core.md CORE-1); the bindings of packages/rust/interface.json replace it
notReleased.legacy/packages/php-ext/composer.json: a language implementation of legacy/, kept for its own tests and as the other side of the differential tests until its removal (docs/spec/core.md CORE-1); the bindings of packages/rust/interface.json replace it
